files.description: Add tailwindcss, postcss, and autoprefixer as devDependencies -- they were referenced by tailwind.config.js/postcss.config.cjs but never actually declared or installed, so Tailwind was never really running.
A leftover deprecated stub (kept alongside the real postcss.config.cjs) was still being picked up by Vite ahead of the real config, resulting in zero PostCSS plugins running at all.
